Built from the LGD village boundaries (12 KML files), LGD_Assembly_Constituencies.kml and Datagov_Pincode_Boundaries.kml. Overlap is the share of each PIN code's area inside a constituency; constituencies under 1% are left out unless a village falls in them. Villages are placed by an interior point of their boundary. Some states' constituency boundaries are pre-delimitation in the source file and are marked as such. Generated 26 October 2026.
